target: mean of best-GT-IoU >= .50,.55,...,.95; candidate quality surrogate, not exact AP
weighting: equal source mass, equal queries within source, equal candidates within query; normalize mean row weight to 1
candidate_policy: original 1fps E4 curve pool; preserve every geometry; no new windows or decoding threshold
control_scope: structure scorer sees five duration/position features on the same query-generated pools; not a query-free retrieval control
primary: full minus E4 internal-validation mAP; full minus structure is a mechanistic control
secondary: R1@.5/.7, short mAP, top5 oracle, five-fold source-group OOF and resubstitution fit
stop_rule: exactly five-fold plus full-data fits for two scorers; no hyperparameter/feature/seed/checkpoint/decoder search or per-result reruns
failure_policy: retain empty predictions and full denominators, report failures; invalid frozen inputs abort rather than silently change selection
scope: official-train source-disjoint internal study, previously observed validation; no independent generalization or automatic default promotion; no encoders, downloads, VLM or fresh query/GT
